options.label: Land it in the repo (Recommended)
options.description: scripts/token_usage.py + hatch script + BK item + trace + CHANGELOG on a feature branch. You run it locally on past /ship transcripts; we decide on the restructuring from that.

options.label: Scratchpad only
options.description: Hand over the file, you run it locally and post the output here. No repo overhead, but the measurement can't be repeated.

options.label: Base-load audit first
options.description: Before more measurement: list which MCP servers/plugins/skills make up the 74k base load and what can be switched off per environment.
